title: Finite supported diagonal projection is the divisor Chern adjunct
statement:
theorem diagonalTrace_finiteDivisorAdjoint
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)] (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (hδ : IsDiagonalLimit l Y hY D δ)
    (f : diagonalSurface Y ⟶ ProjectiveLine Y)
    (p : Presentation l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f)
    (a : SupportedSource l Y f p.Rc) (n : ℕ) :
    let E := ULift.{u} (Padic l)
    let V := p.restrictionS.F.mapDerivedCategory
    let ev := ((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (DiagonalMod l (ProjectiveLine Y))).obj
      (op n)).mapDerivedCategory
    (diagonalCompletedUnderlying l (ProjectiveLine Y)).map
        (a.hom ≫ p.Rc.R.map δ) ≫ p.sourceMap l E ≫
        (p.LS.projection n).app _ ≫ ev.map (p.varying.inv.app _) =
      (p.coefficientsS.unitMap l E p.LS ≫ (p.LS.projection n).app _) ≫
        ev.map (V.map
          ((SpTowerShriek.adjunction l E p.base p.model.geometry).homEquiv _ _
            ((p.model.coefficientPullback.derivedIso l E).hom ≫
              SpTowerClasses.firstChern l E p.chernX
                (SpTowerClasses.diagonalPic Y))))

proof.text: Obtain the finite direct-image operation Phi, together with its normalization equations on every supported completed arrow and every geometric arrow, from diagonalTrace_finiteAdjunction_factorization. This step uses no diagonal limit or Chern identity.

Apply diagonalTrace_finiteCartierChern on the surface with p.chernX, p.normalizedX, p.finiteX, p.restrictionX, p.coefficientsX and p.LX. It identifies the finite projection of the supported completed diagonal after forgetting support with the finite first Chern arrow of diagonalPic Y, before direct image or adjunction.

Apply congrArg Phi to the surface equality. Rewrite its left side with the factorization equation for delta and its right side with the geometric equation for firstChern p.chernX (diagonalPic Y). The resulting equality is the stated divisor-adjunct equation.
